messages:
rhea: Kicking off a cautious v2 slowstart in EU-1 at 5% for 20m. This includes the proxy header normalization change.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 5% (8 hosts) for 20m.

tom: Noted. I'll add a short blurb to release notes calling out that header keys may be case-normalized and that clients should treat headers as case-insensitive.

oliver: Ops question — can we selectively opt-out tenants that have older SDKs?

sasha: Yes, we can pin specific tenants to v1. Recommend pinning any tenant still on sdk<2.3.

rhea: Let's pin tenant-oldshop and tenant-alpha for the first hour. tom, can you file the pin commands?

tom: running:
```
deploybot pin add tenant-oldshop --until 2026-04-05 --reason "legacy sdk"
deploybot pin add tenant-alpha --until 2026-04-05 --reason "legacy sdk"
```
deploy-bot: pins added by tom for tenant-oldshop, tenant-alpha.

emma: SRE, please set a temporary stricter rollback for this window: auto-revert to 0% if v2 5xx > 0.6% for 3m or p95 latency regresses by >200ms.

oliver: setting alerts now. Query: `rate(http_request_errors_total{route="/v2"}[3m]) / rate(http_requests_total{route="/v2"}[3m])` > 0.006 -> page. Also adding dashboard widget.

rhea: Canary started at 14:40 UTC. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: canary start confirmed (14:40 UTC). Traffic ramped to 5%.

emma: small bump in 429s from mobile frontend in EU-1 at 14:44 UTC, ~0.9% of v2 traffic but localized to one edge.

tom: is that due to header normalization? mobile SDK sometimes sends mixed-case auth header.

oliver: yes likely. Suggest toggling header-normalize=false on that edge pool while mobile team cuts a patch.

rhea: Agreed. Tom, can ops flip the flag for eu-1-edge-3?

tom: toggling now: `infra flag set eu-1-edge-3 header_normalize=false`
deploy-bot: feature flag updated for eu-1-edge-3 by tom.

emma: after toggle, 429s dropped to baseline in ~2m. p95 latency unchanged.

rhea: Keep canary at 5% but hold ramp. We'll also keep pins for the two tenants until mobile SDK is released and we re-enable header normalization.

tom: I've updated the release notes with a temporary note: "Header normalization will be disabled in impacted edge pools until mobile SDK 2.3.1 is rolled out. Clients on older SDKs can remain on v1 via pinning."

sasha: Product is sending a note to the top EU customers in the next 10m.

oliver: Action items: 1) Mobile eng to cut SDK 2.3.1 with header-case fix (owner: mobile-team) 2) SRE to watch the alert and be ready to rollback to 0% if threshold hit (owner: oliver) 3) Ops to maintain pins until confirmation (owner: tom) 4) Docs to add compatibility note (owner: tom).

rhea: Thanks. Reopen this thread when mobile patch is published and we'll plan a re-enable window. :white_check_mark:
